name: KorPUS_benchmark
description: A benchmark suite focused on Korean language processing, designed to evaluate models on a range of Korean NLP tasks (e.g., classification, tagging, QA, and generation). It measures language understanding and generation capabilities specific to Korean linguistic phenomena and is intended for both research and model benchmarking. The suite can be used to assess generalization and performance of models trained or adapted for Korean.
reputation: A regionally relevant benchmark with utility for Korean NLP research; adoption is moderate within Korean-language model development communities.
